subject: Proposal: Scale Hosted API commit + tier shift for CartWave
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Margo Ellis <margo.ellis@cartwave.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Scale Hosted API commit + tier shift for CartWave

Hi Margo —

Great to reconnect after the product sync last week. Based on CartWave’s Q2 forecast and the observed 3x spike in inference volume during peak promos, we put together a short proposal to:

- Move CartWave from the current Standard hosted tier to the Business tier (higher burst quota + lower per-token rate).
- Increase the committed monthly throughput from 600M tokens to 1.5B tokens to support anticipated growth and lower unit costs.
- Add a temporary 60-day burst cushion for the next two promos.

I attached a term sheet and a draft SOW with the ops handoff checklist. High-level financials: the uplift reduces effective per-1M-token price by ~22% vs current rates and adds a predictable monthly invoice for budgeting.

If this looks reasonable I can loop in procurement and get legal/finance to prepare the PO/DocuSign. Proposed next step: 30-minute handshake call Monday to confirm SSO and audit log requirements.

Attachments: Redwood_Term_Sheet_CartWave_20260418.pdf, SOW-Hosted-API-Scale.xlsx

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

From: Margo Ellis <margo.ellis@cartwave.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cartwave.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Scale Hosted API commit + tier shift for CartWave

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposal. A few questions from my side and procurement:

1) SSO & SCIM: we need to confirm support for our Okta setup and provisioning cadence (monthly). Can Redwood support SCIM groups for role mapping?
2) Data residency: CartWave requires EU+US audit logs retained for 13 months. Please confirm the audit log retention and access model for hosted customers.
3) Billing cadence: procurement prefers invoicing on the 1st of the month and a net-30 payment term; will the change to committed throughput affect invoicing schedule?

Procurement has looped in our procurement mailbox for PO processing (procurement@cartwave.com).

If we can confirm SSO and log retention, procurement will want the updated term sheet and the PO template. Can you send those and include any redlineable language for log retention and invoicing?

—Margo
Head of Platform | CartWave

Team —

Looping you in. CartWave wants SCIM/Okta provisioning, 13-month audit log retention (EU+US), and invoicing on the 1st with net-30. Procurement will expect a redlineable term sheet and a PO-friendly invoice attachment.

Ask: can legal/finance accept net-30 on this uplift? Also, what guardrails do we need to put on the 60-day burst cushion to avoid runaway overage exposure?

I've attached the term sheet and SOW for context.

Thanks — Olga

[attachment: Redwood_Term_Sheet_CartWave_20260418.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CartWave: scale proposal — procurement questions

Thanks for the context. Quick answers:

- Net-30: Approved for Enterprise upsells in US region for renewals/commit increases; finance will flag for credit hold if invoices age >60 days. Ben, please confirm operational accounting setup.
- SCIM/Okta: Our Private/Hosted control plane supports SCIM provisioning. Ops will need the Okta metadata; add on the SOW a 7-business-day provisioning window.
- Audit logs: Hosted tier supports 13-month retention for logs (EU+US) when enabled; there’s a small add-on ($300/mo) for extended retention and cross-region replication — include as optional line item.
- Burst guardrail: propose a soft cap at 250% of average daily consumption with alerting and an automated pause option. Any overage beyond soft cap billed at the Business burst rate.

I've updated the term sheet with the billing cadence and added a section for SCIM provisioning and the optional log-retention fee. Draft attached.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Growth Pricing | Redwood Inference

[attachment: Redwood_Term_Sheet_CartWave_20260421_v2.pdf]
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Revised term sheet & DocuSign — CartWave commit uplift (CGW-984)

Hi Margo / procurement team —

Thanks for the questions. Attached is the updated term sheet (v2) that:
- Confirms Net-30 invoicing on the 1st of the month
- Adds SCIM/Okta provisioning (7 business days) in the SOW
- Adds an optional 13-month audit log retention add-on fee (line item)
- Defines the burst soft cap and overage-rate treatment

Next steps: if procurement is happy, we can execute via DocuSign. Link below opens the contract with placeholders for PO number and billing contact. I also attached a sample PO template to help speed processing.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABCD-1234-CRT
Attachments: Redwood_Term_Sheet_CartWave_20260421_v2.pdf, SOW-Hosted-API-Scale.xlsx

Happy to jump on a short call to walk procurement through the SOW details.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
